title: Upload
subtitle: Bring your work from your machine as a zip.

help.runs: Each experiment's seals are checked. Anything that does not verify is refused.
help.project: Files under agents/, benchmarks/, experiments/ and policies/ are written. Old versions are kept.
help.agent: Lands in agents/<name>/. Leave the name empty to use the zip's folder name.

drop.tooLarge: This zip is larger than {{mb}} MiB; split it into several zips.

failed: Upload failed. Check the zip and try again.

runs.empty: The zip held no experiment folder. To upload agents or suites, pick the Project folder tab instead.
